t: A gigahertz microcontroller from NXP for touch screens, cameras, and fast networks.
steps: Buy a board such as the NXP MIMXRT1170-EVKB, the Avnet MaaXBoard RT, or the PHYTEC phyBOARD-RT1170.
Get a 5 V power supply and a USB cable for the board.
Install Visual Studio Code and the Zephyr tools following the Zephyr getting started guide.
Build the Zephyr blinky sample for the mimxrt1170_evk board.
Flash it with the onboard debugger and watch the LED blink.
Try the Zephyr hello world sample and read its message in a serial terminal.
Explore MicroPython or the MCUXpresso SDK examples next.
meta: Open Board. From $150. A few stores.
